authority: specification identity grants no cryptographic verification, active policy, publication, migration or production qualification
coordinator: deterministically recompute the custody-complete module and apply the existing exact absolute-total, state-chain, occurrence and effect checks

custody.commitments: rebuild effect root, private-port effect root and port root, journal effect/port roots and semantic receipt root from the completed values
custody.conservation_scalars: derive pre and post owned_and_custodied atoms separately from exact private projections
custody.frame: every custody owner, asset, domain and amount is identical before and after transfer
custody.limits: at most 4096 canonical custody rows; no undeclared asset; validate complete table before acceptance
custody.physical_total: sum physical account rows plus custody rows for each asset equals its declared supply
custody.preserved: account/fee rows, supply, zero issue/burn, policies, lane writes, occurrence and empty external outbox/terminal effects retain the existing transfer meanings

fee_mirror: the existing global fee-mirror check remains mandatory; local acceptance does not guarantee route admission when fee owner is sender
global_scope: reserves are empty in the restricted ASSET allocation relation; claimant liabilities do not enter the physical supply sum, remain unchanged across this route, and remain subject to the existing same-control-domain claimant-backing checks
historical_behavior: legacy APIs and image subjects retain their existing semantics; this successor is selected only through new explicit APIs

leaf.account_deltas: sum signed events per principal: sender -amount-fee; recipient +amount; fee owner +fee
leaf.authorization: sender equals supplied context subject; cryptographic authentication is a separate mandatory admission boundary
leaf.rejection: unchanged input economic state and roots; empty effects
leaf.rows: complete (asset,owner,accounts) keys; delete zeros; canonical (asset,owner) order; maximum 4096 balances
leaf.widths: absolute amounts and supply u128; coalesced account deltas and fee i128; check before committed construction

ownership_nonclaim: this transfer-step bundle preserves validated custody and liability rows but does not select genesis custody owners, claimant identities, control domains, deposit or withdrawal policy, or migration
policy: flat transfer fee, fee owner and enabled asset are explicit governed inputs; no constants selected here
route: bind governed profile, registries, policy and occurrence; use the matching custody coordinator; apply the existing full-state allocation and effect refinement checks
wire_family: GlobalSettlementABI V1; unchanged transfer input, accepted value, private port and module/lane/route journals
